name: games
title: Games
description: Every game in one list, the installed ones and the ones you can still get, and their leaderboards. Enter opens a game, or installs it first and then opens it.
author: pal

store.tagline: All the games in one list, one Enter away
features: One row per game with its tile and tagline; typing narrows the list
Games you have not installed yet are listed too, under Not installed
`enter` opens a game, or installs it, waits for it to load and opens it
`cmd+l` on a game shows its leaderboards: a tab per board, all time, this week or today, your own row marked, anonymous players hidden with `a`
A failed install stays as a row saying why; `escape` comes back to the list

screenshots.caption: The games you have first, then every other game pal's registry offers, each with its tile and what it is; Enter installs one and starts it
Typing narrows the list, taglines included: daily finds the daily puzzles; Enter opens one
A game's leaderboards: today's Wordle, fewest guesses first, anonymous players marked and your own row ringed

actions.title: Install and play
actions.description: On a game not installed: installs it from its registry, waits for it to load, opens it.

actions.title: Leaderboards
actions.description: The game's boards: `left` and `right` walk them, `p` the period, `a` hides anonymous players, `s` signs in when you are signed out.

games.title: Games
games.description: Every game, installed or on offer; Enter opens it, installing it first when needed.

leaderboards.title: Leaderboards
leaderboards.description: A game's leaderboards: a tab per board, the period, anonymous players shown or hidden. Opens on the last game looked at; G for another.
